subject: Access authorization checkpoint — SAML/SCIM artifacts for SOC 2
messages:
From: Marisa Chen <marisa.chen@horizonpay.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: security@horizonpay.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 — SCIM/SAML/RBAC artifacts we need

Alex —

Thanks for helping HorizonPay with the SOC 2 readiness packet. The security team kicked off a SIG/SOC review and we need a set of IAM artifacts to complete our evidence bundle. High-level request below — target delivery by EOD Friday would be ideal.

What we need:
- SCIM delta feed (or snapshot + delta) covering past 90 days; include timestamps, user id, operation (create/update/delete), and reference to group assignments. CSV or JSON fine.
- Samples of SAML assertions for 3 users (one admin, one regular user, one service account) — include raw XML and decoded attributes.
- RBAC/privilege matrix: mapping groups -> roles -> permissions; include any service account role assignments and last-used timestamps if available.
- Inventory of privileged/service accounts with owner contact (can redact email domains if needed).
- Any documented least-privilege policy or role pruning activity in the last 6 months.

Questions: can you provide anonymized user ids (HorizonPay-12345 style)? Are there any PII concerns if we receive raw SAML XML? We also need a secure link for upload (Box/Drive preferred).

If you prefer, we can hop on a quick 20-minute call to align scope — David Park (cc) is the compliance lead.

Appreciate it,
Marisa Chen
Senior Security Program Manager
HorizonPay

---
From: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marisa Chen <marisa.chen@horizonpay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 — SCIM/SAML/RBAC artifacts we need

Marisa —

Thanks for the clear list. We can assemble everything you requested. Quick summary of our plan and a couple clarifying questions so we can deliver exactly what you need: 

Planned deliverables (targeting 2027-03-18 EOD unless you need earlier):
- scim_delta_sample.csv — 90-day delta with anonymized IDs (prefix: HP-<6 digits>), event timestamps in UTC, and op types (create/update/delete).
- saml_assertion_examples.txt — raw XML for three personas + a short decoded attributes table.
- rbac_matrix_2027Q1.xlsx — groups -> roles -> permissions, and a separate tab listing service accounts and owners.
- service_account_index.pdf — inventory + short runbook pointers where available.
- policy_snapshot.pdf — excerpt of our least-privilege / role management policy and most recent role-pruning worklog.

Clarifying questions:
1) Anonymization: HP- prefix and 6-digit suffix OK? We will remove email addresses and replace with <redacted>@example.com where strictly necessary.
2) SAML assertions: is including NameID and attributes (email, groups, role) acceptable if we redact email domains? Or would you prefer fully redacted names?
3) Delivery method: we will upload to a restricted Google Drive folder and share the link with access limited to the emails you provide. Is Drive acceptable?

If those answers work, we’ll proceed and I’ll upload partial artifacts as they’re ready. I’m looping in Laura (Security Ops) and Tessa (Compliance) to help with extraction and anonymization.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Lead, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Alex —

Thanks for the quick plan — that looks good. A few replies inline: 

- HP-###### anonymization format is perfect.
- For SAML, please include NameID and groups; you can redact email domains (e.g., alice@redacted.com). We just need the attribute names and example values for mapping.
- Google Drive share is fine, but please set viewer access to specific emails only (do not set link-wide access).

Additional asks that came up during a quick sync with David: 
- Last-used timestamps for privileged/service accounts are high value for our risk assessment — if you can include last activity (last successful login/API use) that would help.
- Any evidence of role pruning (PR number or ticket reference) would suffice rather than a full runbook.

We’ll plan a 20-minute call to confirm scope — does 2027-03-16 11:00 AM PT work for you? David will join.

Thanks,
Marisa
